2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Grubauer will start the Global Series vs. Carolina on Thursday.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Grubauer had an encouraging start to the 2026-27 season, but has returned to the inconsistent play that has made him a secondary option in recent seasons. The 34-year-old German goalie has started only once in the past two weeks, in a game where he allowed four goals on 14 shots (.714 SV%) in a 6-2 loss to the Calgary Flames. The Kraken enter Thursday's game as sizeable +248 home favourites against the Eastern Conference-leading Carolina Hurricanes.
2026-11-12.awayNewsDetails: Bussi will start the Global Series vs. Seattle on Thursday.
2026-11-12.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Bussi had a surprising breakout last season as a 27-year-old rookie, ultimately leading the Hurricanes to a Stanley Cup Championship. However, early-season struggles and outstanding play from counterpart Pytor Kochetkov have made Bussi a secondary option in 2026-27. The 28-year-old Bussi has played only once in the past three weeks, but he was serviceable, saving 24 of 27 shots (.889 SV%) in a 5-3 win over the New York Islanders. The Hurricanes enter Thursday's game as significant -286 road favourites against the Seattle Kraken, who are 2-3-0 in their past five games.

2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Swayman will start Thursday vs. Montreal.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Jeremy Swayman had a miserable 2024-25 season after signing a massive eight-year contract extension, posting an ugly 3.11 GAA and .892 SV% in 58 games (22-29-7). That said, he followed it up with a solid 2025-26 season and has started 2026-27 as one of the top goalies in the NHL. The 27-year-old Swayman was outstanding in his most recent outing, saving 41 of 42 shots (.976 SV%) in a 4-1 win over the Florida Panthers. He has allowed two or fewer goals in seven of 13 games this season. The Bruins enter Thursday's game as -119 home favourites against the Montreal Canadiens, who are coming off a 2-1 overtime loss to the Minnesota Wild.
2026-11-12.awayNewsDetails: Fowler will start in Boston on Thursday.
2026-11-12.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Fowler was outstanding in the opening month of the season, posting a 1.84 GAA and .932 SV% in eight October games (7-1-0). That said, he had a catastrophic meltdown in his first game of November, as the Montreal Canadiens blew a 4-0 lead over the Winnipeg Jets in the final three minutes of an eventual 5-4 overtime loss. That said, the 21-year-old Fowler wasn't phased by the loss, bouncing back in his next two games (1-0-1), saving 48 of 52 shots (.923 SV%).

2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Greaves will start vs. Tampa Bay on Thursday.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails:
Greaves is coming off an impressive rookie season but has struggled to start the 2026-27 season, recently losing starts to Cam Talbot, who has been more consistent. The 25-year-old's struggles continued in his most recent outing, as he allowed five goals on 36 shots (.861 SV%) in a 5-2 loss to the Buffalo Sabres. He has lost four straight (0-4-0), posting a 4.31 GAA and .847 SV%. The Blue Jackets enter Thursday's game as slight +101 home underdogs against a Tampa Bay Lightning team coming off an explosive 8-3 win over the Buffalo Sabres last night.

2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Ullmark (lower-body) will start vs. Colorado on Thursday.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Ullmark has not played since suffering a lower-body injury on October 21st, with Samuel Ersson helping the Senators stay afloat during his absence. That said, the team is eager for Ullmark to return to the crease, given his outstanding start to the 2026-27 season. The 33-year-old Ullmark has a dazzling 1.33 GAA and .945 SV% in eight games (7-1-0). The Senators enter Thursday's game as slight -106 home favourites against a Colorado Avalanche team that has outscored opponents 10-3 in its past two games (2-0-0).
2026-11-12.awayNewsDetails: Wedgewood will start in Ottawa on Thursday.
2026-11-12.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Wedgewood's tremendous 2025-26 season, with a 2.02 GAA and .921 SV% in 45 appearances (31-6-6), was expected to earn him at least a timeshare in 2026-27, but he has struggled immensely this season. The 34-year-old Wedgewood has not played since November 3, when he was pulled midway through the game after allowing four goals on nine shots (.556 SV%) in a 7-2 loss to the Columbus Blue Jackets. He has allowed three or more goals in four of five games this season (1-3-1). The Avalanche enter Thursday's game as -101 road underdogs against the Ottawa Senators, who are 2-0-1 in their past three games.

2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Hellebuyck will start vs. Washington on Thursday.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Hellebuyck controversially had the night off on Tuesday in a game against his former team, the Winnipeg Jets, but he will return to the crease on Thursday. The 33-year-old Hellebuyck has been solid since joining the Devils, without a loss, posting a 1.96 GAA and .913 SV% in five outings (5-0-0). He recorded a 23-save shutout, his first of the season, in his most recent game, a 4-0 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs. The Devils enter Thursday's game as -150 home favourites against a Washington Capitals team coming off a 3-2 overtime win over the Ottawa Senators.

2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Stolarz will start vs. Minnesota on Thursday.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails: When the Maple Leafs signed Bobrovsky to a three-year, $7 million AAV contract ($21M total) in the offseason, the hope was that he could solidify their crease and return the team to the postseason. That said, Bobrovsky has struggled, and Stolarz has been the more reliable option on most nights. The 32-year-old Stolarz has a solid 2.26 GAA and .929 SV% in his last four games (3-1-0). The Maple Leafs enter Thursday's game as +149 home underdogs against the Central Division-leading Minnesota Wild, who are riding a three-game winning streak.
2026-11-12.awayNewsDetails: Wallstedt will start in Toronto on Thursday.
2026-11-12.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Wallstedt has deservedly been the busiest goalie in the NHL this season, playing 17 of 20 games, posting a tremendous 1.93 GAA and .925 SV% with a 12-2-3 record. The 23-year-old Swedish goalie was excellent in Minnesota's previous game, saving 27 of 28 shots (.964 SV%) in a 2-1 overtime win against the Montreal Canadiens. He has allowed two or fewer goals in four straight games. The Wild enter Thursday's game as -169 road favourites against a struggling Toronto Maple Leafs team that is amid a four-game losing streak.

2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Schmid will start vs. Detroit on Thursday.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Schmid has been serviceable for Florida this season and kept his team afloat during a multi-week stint when Jacob Markstrom was sidelined with an injury. That said, the 26-year-old Schmid struggled in his most recent outing, allowing four goals on 31 shots (.871 SV%) in a 4-3 loss to the Washington Capitals. Still, he has a solid 2.26 GAA and .911 SV% in his last four games (3-1-0). The Panthers enter Thursday's game as -164 home favourites against a Detroit Red Wings team that has scored just five total goals during a four-game losing streak.
2026-11-12.awayNewsDetails: Gibson will start in Florida on Thursday.
2026-11-12.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Gibson had a tremendous inaugural season with the Red Wings in 2025-26, nearly leading them to a postseason berth, but 2026-27 has been rocky for Gibson. That said, Gibson played well in his most recent outing, saving 30 of 33 shots (.909 SV%), but fell short in a 3-2 loss to the St. Louis Blues. The 33-year-old goalie has a 3.54 GAA and .857 SV% in his last five games (1-4-0). The Red Wings enter Thursday's game as +146 road underdogs against the Florida Panthers, coming off a 4-1 win over the Columbus Blue Jackets.

2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Oettinger will start vs. Winnipeg on Thursday.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The well-rested Stars return to action on Thursday against the Winnipeg Jets. The Stars last played on November 7th, when Oettinger saved 20 of 23 shots (.870 SV%) in a 4-3 win over the San Jose Sharks. The 27-year-old Oettinger leads the NHL with three shutouts, but he has battled some adversity lately, allowing three or more goals in four of his last five games (4-1-0). The Stars enter Thursday's game as -170 home favourites against a surging Winnipeg Jets team riding a four-game winning streak.
2026-11-12.awayNewsDetails: Skinner will start in Dallas on Thursday.
2026-11-12.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Skinner has been inconsistent this season, as he has been for most of his career, but he is on a three-game winning streak, posting a 2.96 GAA and an .870 SV%. That said, the 28-year-old goalie has allowed three or more goals in four of his past five games (2-3-0). The Jets enter Thursday's game as +153 road underdogs against a Dallas Stars team that beat them 3-2 in overtime earlier this season, a game in which Skinner saved 35 of 38 shots (.921 SV%).

2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Vejmelka is expected to start vs. St. Louis on Thursday.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails: While rookie Sebastian Cossa has played well at times for the Mammoth, he has lacked consistency and has failed to earn more starts despite Karel Vejmelka's ongoing struggles. Vejmelka has allowed three or more goals in six straight games (1-5-0), posting an ugly .840 SV%. In his most recent outing, the 30-year-old Czech goalie allowed three goals on 20 shots (.850 SV%) in a 4-2 loss to the Ottawa Senators. The Mammoth enter Thursday's contest as slight -108 home favourites against the St. Louis Blues, who have lost three of their past four games (1-2-1).
2026-11-12.awayNewsDetails: Hofer will start in Utah on Thursday.
2026-11-12.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Hofer has been reliable on most nights, earning his share of the crease and making veteran Jordan Binnington the clear-cut backup goalie in St. Louis. The 26-year-old Hofer is coming off a solid outing, saving 29 of 31 shots (.935 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Detroit Red Wings. He has allowed two or fewer goals in six of his last eight games (5-3-0), posting a .927 SV%. The Blues enter Thursday's game as -102 road underdogs against a Utah Mammoth team on a three-game losing streak (0-2-1).

2026-11-12.homeNewsDetails: Kuemper is expected to start vs. the Islanders on Thursday.
2026-11-12.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Anton Forsberg hasn't played poorly this season, but Darcy Kuemper remains the only Kings goalie with a win and will return to the crease on Thursday. That said, Kuemper struggled in his most recent outing, allowing four goals on 18 shots (.778 SV%) in a 5-2 loss to the Pittsburgh Penguins. The veteran 36-year-old goalie has a 2.98 GAA and .896 SV% in his last six games (5-1-0). The Kings enter Thursday's game as -122 home favourites against a New York Islanders team they defeated 3-2 earlier this season in a game where Kuemper saved 41 of 43 shots (.953 SV%).
2026-11-12.awayNewsDetails: Sorokin is in the starter's crease at New York's morning skate.
2026-11-12.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Sorokin has had an up-and-down 2026-27 season, but was outstanding in his most recent outing, saving 39 of 41 shots (.951 SV%) in a 3-2 shootout loss to the San Jose Sharks. It ended a four-game stretch where the 31-year-old Russian goalie had allowed three or more goals in four straight games (1-2-1), posting a .877 SV%. The Islanders enter Thursday's game as +108 road underdogs against a Los Angeles Kings team that has been outscored 8-2 in their past two games (0-2-0).
